name: Starlight Dreamers
source:
Welcome to Shibuya High School, a seemingly normal all-boys school at first glance - and it probably would be - if you weren't in it. You play as Hiro Matsui, a girl with too much time on her hands and is too bored with her life. So, what does she do? She decides to sneak into the nearest all-boys school just to see how it's like. This is where the story begins. Hiro meets two beautiful boys, Yuito and Masao. Is there something behind Yuito's cold glare? Something behind the knowing look in Masa's eyes? And who is the mysterious shadow lurking outside the gym at night?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26715]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到涩谷高中，乍一看，这是一所普通的男子学校 - 如果你不在其中的话，它很可能就是这样。你扮演松井宏，一个有太多空闲时间并且对生活感到太无聊的女孩。那么，她做什么呢？她决定偷偷溜进最近的男子学校，看看那里是什么样子。这就是故事的开始。宏遇到了两个漂亮的男孩，唯人和正男。唯人那冰冷的目光背后是否有什么隐情？Masa的眼神背后隐藏着什么？而深夜潜伏在健身房外的神秘影子又是谁呢？
